entities.name: Grakmaw
entities.description: A massive blind hydra horror that lurked for centuries in a fallen Skyclave on Jwar Isle; turned to stone by Anowon.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: Killed Grakmaw with a Kor potion that turned it to stone.

entities.name: Jwar Isle
entities.description: Island in Ondu where Grakmaw lurked.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: Region of Zendikar containing Jwar Isle.

entities.name: Skyclaves
entities.description: Floating structures; one fell and sheltered Grakmaw, and they rose again.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: Ancient people who made the stoning potion.

events.summary: When the Skyclaves rise again, Grakmaw begins feeding on adventuring parties.
events.quote: When the Skyclaves rose once again, Grakmaw discovered a new source of food

events.summary: Anowon kills Grakmaw with an ancient Kor potion that turns it to stone.
events.quote: Grakmaw was killed by Anowon who used a potion made by the ancient Kor which turned the hydra into stone.

relations.quote: Grakmaw was killed by Anowon who used a potion made by the ancient Kor which turned the hydra into stone.
